```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the given dataset
data = {
    "amount": [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    "is_fraud": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    "transaction_type": ["refund", "payment", "transfer", "payment", "payment"],
    "hour_of_day": [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a bar plot to show the distribution of transactions by hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x="hour_of_day", data=df, order=df["hour_of_day"].value_counts().index)

# Add title and labels
plt.title("Distribution of Transactions by Hour of Day")
plt.xlabel("Hour of Day")
plt.ylabel("Count")

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig("output.png")
```
